scope: Paired sampled pose evidence on Mac; fresh paced full-pipeline comparisons on the selected iPhone where shown. Neither pose coverage nor total counts alone establish accuracy.
phoneScope: Fresh phone comparisons are listed below. The complete 58-clip phone comparison is not finished; unrun cells are explicit. Device results are kept separate.
sampling: Every 2s plus 3 samples around each original corpus event; extra IMG8606 review windows. Joint presence threshold0.3, any observed person, no active-player selection. These are development clips, not a held-out test.

reviewedCohort.scope: The fixed 20 original reviewed clips, first completed run per arm (r1). Existing pilot repeats and supplemental clips are excluded from cohort totals. Totals use only clips with all three valid arms; uncertainty and unreviewed counts remain separate. Labels were visually reviewed by one assistant, with human confirmation pending; this is development recall, not held-out release accuracy. Miss-reason summaries describe diagnostics near the reference time; they are hints, not independently verified causes for every missed contact.
